writer.name: Claude Opus 5.5, the hypnosis guide lane's writer (the splices and their fixes; the words are Emulate's)

findings.label: B7 short landing at paragraph end
examples: Here is a little script you could use:
findings.reason: It is the whole paragraph, a lead-in ending on a colon, as the old line was; the script follows in the next paragraphs.

findings.label: D9 follows the source order
examples: 1/1 paragraphs follow the source's points in its order (agreement 1.00); fine if each part notices something; check T13 and T09 in the tell ledger
findings.reason: It is Emulate's rewrite of the words it replaces (SOURCE.txt), so it follows their points in order by design; the turns are Emulate's own ("Here is a little script").

findings.label: E36/E41 heavy second person
findings.reason: The guide speaks to the reader as "you" throughout; here one "you" in the lead-in to the script.
